The Fluxmaster ability is on the Fluxmaster's datasheet (FP 1.2 l.1306-1310), so its source is the Fluxmaster. Its words are "This unit …", which under Core Rules 19.04 ("abilities/rules that affect a unit (or models in it) apply to every model in an attached unit, until the source of that ability/rule is destroyed") cover the Pink Horrors too while the Fluxmaster lives: see the def fix (ab039ae92add6462).

GW: "■ This unit has Stealth. ■ Melee attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls." (FP 1.2 l.1308-1310). On the datasheet the line is shown as "FLUXMASTER Fluxmaster: Stealth …; melee attacks that target it have -1 to hit rolls", and the small FLUXMASTER label is, per app.html defLine, "the one model of an attached unit it is on", so it reads as protection for the Fluxmaster model only. That is wrong twice: 19.04 extends "this unit" to every model of the attached unit until the Fluxmaster is destroyed, and Stealth only works "If every model in a unit has this ability" (Core Rules 24.33). The signed-off precedent for a part's unit-wide line keeps GW's "this unit" (Meganobz "MEGANOBZ Arrogant Invulnerability: Attacks that target this unit have -1 AP"). Fix: verify/sources/hand/tzeeeeentch.json units["fluxmaster-pink-horrors"].defs["Fluxmaster"].def = "This unit has Stealth (the benefit of cover against ranged attacks); melee attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls" (defOf unchanged, 55ebfa69, the source text is the same).
